mapper.sql: r.payment_status in (2, 4) and ( (r.owner_type = 1 and exists ( select 1 from cms_topic t where t.id = r.owner_id and t.del_flag = 0 and (t.product_type is null or t.product_type <> 2) and (t.member_id = #{ownerMemberId} or exists ( select 1 from cms_registration_merchant rm where rm.topic_id = t.id and rm.member_id = #{ownerMemberId} and rm.audit_status = 1 and rm.del_flag = 0 )) )) or (r.owner_type = 2 and exists ( select 1 from cms_activity a left join cms_topic activity_topic on activity_topic.id = a.topic_id where a.id = r.owner_id and a.member_id = #{ownerMemberId} and a.del_flag = 0 and (activity_topic.id is null or activity_topic.product_type is null or activity_topic.product_type <> 2) )) )

and exists ( select 1 from merchant_customer_tag_assignment a where a.merchant_id = #{query.merchantId} and a.merchant_scope_version = 2 and a.member_id = r.member_id and a.tag_id = #{query.tagId} and a.action = 'ASSIGN' and a.id = ( select max(latest.id) from merchant_customer_tag_assignment latest where latest.merchant_id = a.merchant_id and latest.merchant_scope_version = 2 and latest.member_id = a.member_id and latest.tag_id = a.tag_id ) )

coalesce( nullif(max(case when then r.phone end), ''), nullif(max(case when then u.phone end), '') )

(select pt.title from play_team_member ptm join play_team pt on pt.id = ptm.team_id where ptm.member_id = r.member_id and ptm.status = 1 and pt.owner_type = r.owner_type and pt.owner_id = r.owner_id order by ptm.id desc limit 1)
(select par.role_code from player_activity_role par where par.member_id = r.member_id and r.owner_type = 2 and par.activity_id = r.owner_id order by par.id desc limit 1)

r.member_id as member_id, coalesce(nullif(max(u.nickname), ''), '未留姓名') as customer_name, max(u.avatar) as avatar, as phone, max(case when then 1 else 0 end) as merchant_responsible_contact, sum(case when r.payment_status = 2 and r.verification_status = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as arrived_count, sum(case when r.payment_status = 2 and (r.verification_status is null or r.verification_status <> 1) then 1 else 0 end) as pending_count, sum(case when r.payment_status = 4 then 1 else 0 end) as refunded_count, coalesce(sum(case when r.payment_status = 2 then coalesce(r.payable_amount, r.total_amount, 0) else 0 end), 0) as paid_amount, max(coalesce(r.verification_time, r.create_time)) as last_time, case when min(r.owner_type) = max(r.owner_type) and min(r.owner_type) = 1 then 'TOPIC' when min(r.owner_type) = max(r.owner_type) and min(r.owner_type) = 2 then 'ACTIVITY' else 'MIXED' end as source_type, max() as team_name, max() as role_code

from cms_registration r join ums_member u on u.id = r.member_id and u.del_flag = 0 where
group by r.member_id

sql.if: having sum(case when r.payment_status = 2 and (r.verification_status is null or r.verification_status <> 1) then 1 else 0 end) > 0
having sum(case when r.payment_status = 4 then 1 else 0 end) > 0
having sum(case when r.payment_status = 2 and r.verification_status = 1 then 1 else 0 end) >= 2

having sum(case when r.payment_status = 2 and (r.verification_status is null or r.verification_status <> 1) then 1 else 0 end) = 0 and sum(case when r.payment_status = 4 then 1 else 0 end) = 0 and max(coalesce(r.verification_time, r.create_time)) >= timestampadd(day, -60, current_timestamp) and sum(case when r.payment_status = 2 and r.verification_status = 1 then 1 else 0 end) < 2
having exists ( select 1 from merchant_customer_note note where note.merchant_id = #{query.merchantId} and note.merchant_scope_version = 2 and note.member_id = r.member_id and note.hidden = 0 )

mapper.select:
select , (select note.content from merchant_customer_note note where note.merchant_id = #{query.merchantId} and note.merchant_scope_version = 2 and note.member_id = r.member_id and note.hidden = 0 order by note.create_time desc, note.id desc limit 1) as latest_note, case when sum(case when r.payment_status = 2 and (r.verification_status is null or r.verification_status <> 1) then 1 else 0 end) > 0 then 'pending' when sum(case when r.payment_status = 4 then 1 else 0 end) > 0 then 'abnormal' when max(coalesce(r.verification_time, r.create_time)) < timestampadd(day, -60, current_timestamp) then 'dormant' when sum(case when r.payment_status = 2 and r.verification_status = 1 then 1 else 0 end) >= 2 then 'repeat' else 'new' end as tier
order by last_time desc, member_id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

select r.member_id as member_id, coalesce(nullif(max(u.nickname), ''), '未留姓名') as customer_name, as phone, max(case when then 1 else 0 end) as merchant_responsible_contact from cms_registration r join ums_member u on u.id = r.member_id and u.del_flag = 0 where group by r.member_id

select r.member_id as member_id, coalesce(nullif(max(u.nickname), ''), '未留姓名') as customer_name
order by max(coalesce(r.verification_time, r.create_time)) desc, r.member_id desc limit #{limit}

select r.member_id as member_id, coalesce(nullif(max(u.nickname), ''), '未留姓名') as customer_name, max() as team_name, max() as role_code
order by max(coalesce(r.verification_time, r.create_time)) desc, r.member_id desc limit #{limit}

select count(1) as all_count, coalesce(sum(case when tier = 'pending' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as pending_count, coalesce(sum(case when tier = 'repeat' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as repeat_count, coalesce(sum(case when tier = 'new' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as new_count, coalesce(sum(case when has_note = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as noted_count, coalesce(sum(case when first_order_time >= timestampadd(day, 1 - dayofmonth(current_date), current_date) then 1 else 0 end), 0) as monthly_new_count, coalesce(sum(case when tier = 'dormant' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as dormant_count, coalesce(sum(case when tier = 'abnormal' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as abnormal_count from ( select r.member_id, min(r.create_time) as first_order_time, case when exists ( select 1 from merchant_customer_note note where note.merchant_id = #{query.merchantId} and note.merchant_scope_version = 2 and note.member_id = r.member_id and note.hidden = 0 ) then 1 else 0 end as has_note, case when sum(case when r.payment_status = 2 and (r.verification_status is null or r.verification_status <> 1) then 1 else 0 end) > 0 then 'pending' when sum(case when r.payment_status = 4 then 1 else 0 end) > 0 then 'abnormal' when max(coalesce(r.verification_time, r.create_time)) < timestampadd(day, -60, current_timestamp) then 'dormant' when sum(case when r.payment_status = 2 and r.verification_status = 1 then 1 else 0 end) >= 2 then 'repeat' else 'new' end as tier
) customer_segments
mapper.sql: select #{merchantId} as merchant_id, 2 as merchant_scope_version, r.member_id, coalesce(nullif(max(u.nickname), ''), '未留姓名') as member_nickname, case when is null then null when char_length() = 11 then concat(left(, 3), '****', right(, 4)) else concat(left(, 1), '****') end as member_phone, count(1) as registration_count, sum(case when r.payment_status = 2 then 1 else 0 end) as order_count, coalesce(sum(case when r.payment_status = 2 then coalesce(r.payable_amount, r.total_amount, 0) else 0 end), 0) as order_amount, 0 as coupon_receive_count, 0 as coupon_verify_count, max(coalesce(r.verification_time, r.create_time)) as last_interaction_time, case when sum(case when r.payment_status = 2 and r.verification_status = 1 then 1 else 0 end) >= 2 then 'vip' else 'active' end as customer_stage, 0 as del_flag, now() as create_time, now() as update_time from cms_registration r join ums_member u on u.id = r.member_id and u.del_flag = 0 where and r.member_id = #{customerMemberId} group by r.member_id
mapper.insert:
insert into merchant_customer_profile (merchant_id, merchant_scope_version, member_id, member_nickname, member_phone, registration_count, order_count, order_amount, coupon_receive_count, coupon_verify_count, last_interaction_time, customer_stage, del_flag, create_time, update_time)
on duplicate key update member_nickname = values(member_nickname), member_phone = values(member_phone), registration_count = values(registration_count), order_count = values(order_count), order_amount = values(order_amount), coupon_receive_count = values(coupon_receive_count), coupon_verify_count = values(coupon_verify_count), last_interaction_time = values(last_interaction_time), customer_stage = values(customer_stage), merchant_scope_version = 2, del_flag = 0, update_time = now()

mapper.update: update merchant_customer_profile profile set del_flag = 2, update_time = now() where profile.merchant_id = #{merchantId} and profile.merchant_scope_version = 2 and profile.del_flag = 0 and not exists ( select 1 from cms_registration r where r.member_id = profile.member_id and )
mapper.select: select count(distinct r.member_id) from cms_registration r where
select count(1) from merchant_customer_profile where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and merchant_scope_version = 2 and del_flag = 0

select r.member_id as customer_member_id, coalesce(nullif(max(u.nickname), ''), '未留姓名') as display_name, max(u.avatar) as avatar, sum(case when r.payment_status = 2 and r.verification_status = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as arrived_count, sum(case when r.payment_status = 2 and (r.verification_status is null or r.verification_status <> 1) then 1 else 0 end) as pending_count, sum(case when r.payment_status = 4 then 1 else 0 end) as refunded_count, coalesce(sum(case when r.payment_status = 2 then coalesce(r.payable_amount, r.total_amount, 0) else 0 end), 0) as paid_amount, max(coalesce(r.verification_time, r.create_time)) as last_interaction_time from cms_registration r join ums_member u on u.id = r.member_id and u.del_flag = 0 where group by r.member_id

select r.id as registration_id, case when r.payment_status = 4 then 'REFUNDED' when r.verification_status = 1 then 'ARRIVED' else 'REGISTERED' end as interaction_type, r.activity_title as project_title, case when r.verification_status = 1 and r.verification_time is not null then r.verification_time else r.create_time end as occurred_at from cms_registration r where order by occurred_at desc, registration_id desc limit #{limit}

select concat('campaign-', recipient.id) as timeline_key, 'CAMPAIGN' as timeline_type, coalesce(nullif(campaign.title, ''), case when recipient.channel = 'COUPON' then '优惠券触达' else '站内通知' end) as timeline_title, concat( case when recipient.channel = 'COUPON' then '优惠券' else '站内通知' end, ' · ', case recipient.status when 'DELIVERED' then '已送达' when 'PENDING' then '等待发送' when 'SKIPPED_NO_CONSENT' then '未获授权' when 'SKIPPED_FREQUENCY' then '频控跳过' when 'RETRYABLE_BUSY' then '等待重试' when 'FAILED' then '发送失败' else '状态待确认' end) as timeline_description, coalesce(recipient.delivered_at, recipient.last_attempt_at, recipient.create_time) as occurred_at from merchant_crm_campaign_recipient recipient inner join merchant_crm_campaign campaign on campaign.id = recipient.campaign_id and campaign.merchant_id = recipient.merchant_id where recipient.merchant_id = #{merchantId} and recipient.member_id = #{customerMemberId} order by occurred_at desc, recipient.id desc limit #{limit}

select t.id, t.tag_name, t.tag_color from merchant_customer_tag_assignment a join merchant_customer_tag t on t.id = a.tag_id and t.merchant_id = a.merchant_id and t.merchant_scope_version = 2 and t.del_flag = 0 where a.merchant_id = #{merchantId} and a.merchant_scope_version = 2 and a.member_id = #{customerMemberId} and a.action = 'ASSIGN' and a.id = ( select max(latest.id) from merchant_customer_tag_assignment latest where latest.merchant_id = a.merchant_id and latest.merchant_scope_version = 2 and latest.member_id = a.member_id and latest.tag_id = a.tag_id ) order by a.create_time asc, a.id asc

select count(1) from merchant_customer_tag_assignment a where a.merchant_id = #{merchantId} and a.merchant_scope_version = 2 and a.member_id = #{customerMemberId} and a.action = 'ASSIGN' and a.id = ( select max(latest.id) from merchant_customer_tag_assignment latest where latest.merchant_id = a.merchant_id and latest.merchant_scope_version = 2 and latest.member_id = a.member_id and latest.tag_id = a.tag_id )

select count(1) from merchant_customer_tag_assignment a where a.merchant_id = #{merchantId} and a.merchant_scope_version = 2 and a.member_id = #{customerMemberId} and a.tag_id = #{tagId} and a.action = 'ASSIGN' and a.id = ( select max(latest.id) from merchant_customer_tag_assignment latest where latest.merchant_id = a.merchant_id and latest.merchant_scope_version = 2 and latest.member_id = a.member_id and latest.tag_id = a.tag_id )

select id, merchant_id, member_id, tag_id, action, actor_member_id, request_id, create_time from merchant_customer_tag_assignment where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and merchant_scope_version = 2 and request_id = #{requestId} limit 1
